Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 26, 2026

At OmniConvert, accessible from our website, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by OmniConvert and how we use it.

1. Client-Side Processing

All data conversion operations (including PX to REM, color codes, unit calculations, and text transformations) occur locally on your device browser. We do not store, send, or process your input data on any external server.

2. Cookies and Web Beacons

OmniConvert uses standard cookies. These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited.

3. Google DoubleClick DART Cookie

Google is one of a third-party vendor on our site. It also uses cookies, known as DART cookies, to serve ads to our site visitors based upon their visit to our site and other sites on the internet.

4. Contact Us

If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us through our Contact Page.
